title: AG60094: Seed Technology
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Seed multiplication with reference to production and harvesting of hybrid,
composite and improved varieties of crops, seed certification, seed processing
with reference to drying, cleaning, processing and treatment of seed packaging,
post harvest control of insect, pest and fungi in storage, packaging, seed
testing, seed germination and vigour, maintenance and distribution of breeders
seed, foundation seed and certified seeds.
